question: Is Gemini on the shared pipeline no worse than the one-prompt Gemini brain, on the same days?
change: Gemini on the understand, decide and act, say pipeline (brain 'pipeline'), against the one-prompt brain ('frontier')
why: The pipeline replaces the one-prompt brain only if it's no worse; run once with --brain frontier, then with --brain pipeline, and compare the catalogues.

scenarios.why: work, errands and changes of plan in one day
many small requests, several at once
something runs late and the day has to move
a low-energy day: fewer, shorter messages
a first day with the app

bar: Written after the one-prompt run had started (its first two day lines were seen, nothing else). The pipeline is no worse if, on the same days: every friction kind is on at most one more day than with the one-prompt brain; the total of days with any friction is at most one more; no new kind is about wrong list changes, a destructive action, or the app's internal text shown to the person; the Joplin checks stay clean (nothing written into a routine, no line twice, nothing done left open); and median trust at bed is no more than 1 lower.
